sources.entry: Endurain - Fitness tracking service designed to give users full control over their data and hosting environment. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker

summary.name: Endurain
summary.one_liner: Endurain is a self-hosted fitness tracking service for importing, viewing and sharing workouts, with gear and component tracking, that gives users control over their data.
use_cases: sync Strava or Garmin Connect activities to a private server
track bicycle, shoe and wetsuit usage
monitor when bike components need replacing
import GPX, TCX or FIT activity files
run a multi-user fitness tracker for a household or club
summary.what_it_does: Endurain imports activities from manual or bulk uploads of .gpx, .tcx and .fit files, with .fit preferred, and can sync activities and gear from Strava and activities, gear and body composition from Garmin Connect. It provides activity feeds, week and month statistics, user pages, and follower viewing with basic privacy settings. Gear tracking covers items such as wetsuits, bicycles, shoes and skis, plus component tracking for parts like chains, and default gear per activity type. It also logs weight, steps and sleep, supports goals and notifications, and offers multi-language, imperial/metric and light/dark interface options. It is deployed via a Docker image configured through environment variables, with a docker-compose example in the repository.
notable: Gear component tracking for replacement schedules (e.g., bike chains)
Supports OIDC/SAML SSO, MFA TOTP and admin-approved sign-up
Public demo environment that resets daily
caveats: Demo data resets daily at midnight, so it is not for storing important data
Planned features are listed on an external ROADMAP.md file, not detailed on the page
Trademark use for commercial purposes (paid hosting or services) requires written permission
